name: upi-id-input
title: UPI ID Input
description: UPI ID field that cleans pasted upi://pay links and catches emails, typo'd handles (@okaxsi), app names as handles (@gpay), wrong-length or +91 phone IDs and older @paytm IDs, then reads back the registered name from your check and flags a mismatch.

meta.stops: UPI payment to the wrong VPA
meta.summary: Catches mistyped UPI IDs, cleans pasted upi://pay links and reads back the registered name, so money isn't sent to the wrong VPA.
meta.server: Resolve the payee name server-side through your PSP before payment, and show it from that response, not from the link.
catches: Pasted upi://pay links, reduced to the pa address
Email addresses typed as UPI IDs
App names typed as handles (@gpay → its real handles)
Phone-number IDs with the wrong length or a +91 prefix
Registered name that differs from the expected or link-claimed name
limits: Format looks valid ≠ exists: only your verify callback can confirm the ID and its registered name
Handle list is common handles, not NPCI's full list
a11y: Visible <label>; aria-invalid and status via aria-describedby
Status and suggestions in a polite live region
Handle suggestions are buttons with aria-labels
